focus_areas: Structural integrity of the pendant bail (connection between locket and chain)
Realism of metal reflections vs. diffuse shading
Clarity of individual chain links and wire-wrapping details
Edge sharpness between gemstones and metal settings
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'engraved' details on the locket. AI often fails to render coherent, deep engravings, resulting in blurry surface noise. Also, check if the 'clear' beads actually show any refraction or if they look like opaque grey shapes. Verify if the chain links maintain consistent topology or if they randomly merge into each other.
image_description: A close-up studio shot of an ornate, vintage-style necklace against a plain white background. The necklace features a central gold-toned heart-shaped locket pendant with an engraved floral design. The chain consists of intricate metalwork with pink oval cabochon stones, smaller clear faceted beads, and decorative metal filigree elements. The structure appears to be a bib or statement necklace rather than a simple chain.
